description: A community-garden plot holder who cannot tend the plot this season must decide whether to accept a neighbor's produce-and-compost exchange for its use, then settle the exact seasonal terms and watering arrangement with help from another plot holder.

shared_context.S1: Nina has one community-garden plot available for someone else to tend from May 15 through October 15.
shared_context.S2: Nina cannot tend the plot herself this season and will make the final call on any informal exchange.
shared_context.S3: Owen has said he is interested in using the plot, and Farah gardens in the adjacent section.
shared_context.S4: At their garden check-ins, Nina routinely asks each person in turn for practical terms or concerns before agreeing to an arrangement.

PF1.text: Owen's specific proposal is to use the plot from May 15 through October 15, deliver 18 produce baskets to Nina during the season, and bring six 40-liter bags of compost, with no cash payment.

PF2.text: Farah personally checked the shared hose connection yesterday and found it shut off for the season; keeping the plot watered requires the user to bring two 20-liter cans every Tuesday and Thursday, and Farah has not told Nina this yet.

acceptance_conditions: The exchange must be accepted with Owen as the plot user.
The use period must be exactly May 15 through October 15.
Owen must provide exactly 18 produce baskets.
Owen must provide exactly six 40-liter compost bags and no cash payment.
The settlement must confirm that Owen will bring two 20-liter water cans every Tuesday and Thursday.
The watering requirement must be recorded as an informal commitment.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'watering' and ('20-liter' in c['detail'] or '20 liter' in c['detail']) and ('Tuesday and Thursday' in c['detail'] or 'Tuesday/Thursday' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Owen's exact proposal changes the settlement to Owen as user, May 15-October 15 dates, 18 produce baskets, six compost bags, and zero cash.
The shut-off hose changes the watering plan from ordinary hose use to exactly two 20-liter cans every Tuesday and Thursday, which must be committed to and cited.
